description: Build a part of the house the whole way (a porch, a roof, a bay window …): the trips to the wilds for what's short, the work at the bench, then the building itself at home, in stages anyone can watch. Every step goes on the plan with real clock times.

part.description: The part: its id (seaside/turned-posts), its name, or a word in it (porch).

name: build
title: Build a house part
